items.title: Svedala kommun (Sweden) — all municipal IT systems down
items.summary: A ransomware attack on the Swedish municipality of Svedala took all municipal IT systems offline.

items.title: Bernardusscholen Oudenaarde (Belgium) — student and staff data stolen
items.summary: Data relating to around 4,200 students and employees was stolen in an attack on the Belgian school group.

items.title: Qilin claims Japanese electronics manufacturer
items.summary: CYFIRMA's weekly intelligence report lists a Japanese electronics manufacturing company as compromised by Qilin ransomware.

items.title: Cl0p Oracle E-Business Suite extortion campaign — nearly 30 major corporations
items.summary: Between July and October, Cl0p exploited an Oracle E-Business Suite zero-day to exfiltrate data from nearly 30 organizations, with Harvard University, Envoy Air and the Washington Post among the named victims.

items.title: Ransomware data theft up 275% in 2026
items.summary: Security Boulevard reports ransomware data theft surged 275% in 2026, with schools, hospitals and government agencies accounting for some of the largest claims.

items.title: Black Kite 2026 Ransomware Report — 7,551 victims, up 24.9%
items.summary: Black Kite's annual report counts 7,551 publicly named ransomware victims, a 24.9% year-over-year increase.

ransomware.note: KonBriefing lists 12 documented cyber attacks so far in October across Germany, South Korea, Sweden, Belgium, Denmark, France, Lithuania, Poland and the USA.

items.title: Azure — two incidents across 18 regions in 40 hours (Sep 29 – Oct 1)
items.summary: A host OS maintenance rollout on Azure's gateway fleet knocked gateway services offline across 18 regions; Microsoft halted the rollout after customers reported connectivity failures.

items.title: Azure OpenAI Sweden — failed API calls for nearly six hours
items.summary: The second of the two Azure incidents left Azure OpenAI customers in Sweden with failing API calls for close to six hours.

items.title: Cloudflare, Akamai, Twilio and Zoom reporting problems (Oct 5)
items.summary: An outage tracker shows four services reporting problems as of October 5, while AWS, Google Cloud and Azure report no active incidents.

items.title: Forrester: at least two major multi-day hyperscaler outages predicted for 2026
items.summary: Forrester predicts at least two major multi-day outages in 2026 as AWS, Azure and Google Cloud prioritize AI infrastructure over aging legacy systems.

outage.note: No active hyperscaler incidents as of this morning; the Azure gateway events of Sep 29 – Oct 1 are the most recent major disruption.

items.title: Citrix NetScaler ADC / Gateway — two critical zero-days exploited globally
items.summary: CISA added CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772 to KEV; each independently enables remote code execution and both are under active exploitation worldwide.

items.title: Fortinet FortiMail path traversal added to KEV (Oct 1)
items.summary: CISA added CVE-2026-104286, a Fortinet FortiMail path traversal vulnerability, to the KEV catalog on evidence of active exploitation.

items.title: Zammad — two flaws added to KEV (Oct 2)
items.summary: CISA added CVE-2026-102489 (session fixation) and CVE-2026-102490 (improper privilege management) in the Zammad helpdesk platform to KEV.

items.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager authentication bypass reported under active exploitation
items.summary: A critical authentication bypass in Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager was reported added to KEV on October 2 following reports of active exploitation.

items.title: Super Typhoon Choi-Wan active in the Western Pacific
items.summary: Super Typhoon Choi-Wan is active in the Western Pacific alongside Typhoon Nolo and newly designated Tropical Depression Koguma.

items.title: Typhoon Nolo crosses in from the Central Pacific
items.summary: Typhoon Nolo has arrived in the Western Pacific basin from the Central Pacific, adding to an active basin.

items.title: Hurricane Rachel — 90 kt (Category 2), heading west
items.summary: Hurricane Rachel was at 90 knots, Category 2 strength, tracking westward as of the October 4 tropical update.

items.title: Atlantic enters October with no hurricanes — a satellite-era first
items.summary: The 2026 Atlantic season has produced eight named storms but no hurricanes; October shifts development toward the Caribbean and Gulf, closer to Florida.

items.title: Bull Fire north of Verdi, Nevada — 1,274 acres, 40% contained
items.summary: The Bull Fire north of Verdi, Nevada was estimated at 1,274 acres with 40% containment in early October.

items.title: M 4.7 — 5 km NNE of Korumburra, Australia (Oct 02)
items.summary: USGS-significant M 4.7 earthquake near Korumburra, Victoria; green PAGER alert, no tsunami.

items.title: M 4.2 — 6 km WNW of Wauna, Washington (Sep 29)
items.summary: USGS-significant M 4.2 earthquake near Wauna, Washington; green PAGER alert, no tsunami.

physical.note: No large earthquakes this week — both USGS-significant events were below M 5 with green alerts.
